test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dull
solution:
The correct answer is **Bright.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Here let's see the meaning of the correct answer with some examples:

__
 
• **BRIGHT** means quick learner; gifted

 
 
• * Eg*. Ram is a bright student.
 
 
 
• **DULL** means not sharp or intelligent.
 
 
• *** Eg.*** He really is the dullest boy in the class.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here let's explain the meaning of the other given words with some examples:

 
• **COLOURED **means having a color or colors, specially opposed to being black, white or neutral.

 
 
• ***Eg***. He has a set of *coloured* pencils. 
 
 
 
• **CLEVER **means skilled at doing or achieving something; talented.
 
 
• *** Eg.*** Harry was never been *clever,* but he tries very hard.
 
 
 
• **YOUTHFUL** means young; characteristic of young people.
 
 
• *** Eg. ***She has a very *youthful *skin.
